answers.question: Why this role?
answers.answer: The work matches what I do well: helping people get unstuck and keeping their equipment running. I would like to do that for a team that works remotely.

answers.question: Describe a relevant project.
answers.answer: I would point to the project in my profile that is closest to this work and explain what I built and what it changed for the people using it.

answers.question: Availability / hours per week
answers.answer: I can work the hours the role asks for. I am happy to agree a schedule with overlap for your team.

answers.question: Expected rate
answers.answer: My rate is open to discussion based on the scope of the work.

answers.question: Tell me about yourself (60-90 seconds)
answers.answer: I work in IT support. I like solving problems for real people and writing down what I did so the next person does not start from zero. I am looking for a remote role where I can keep doing that.
